pricing_spine.directive: User 2026-07-08: $1/page is dumb -> $1/week x 52. User 2026-07-08 (reframe): tiers must not let a weekly subscriber capture everything; use $1/issue anchor + exclusive content per tier.
pricing_spine.principle: Free=funnel. $1/issue anchors value. Each ascending tier adds EXCLUSIVE content (not just rebundle). Commitment discount: longer commit = lower $/day, but only Annual is 'complete'.

derived_from: SERIES-BIBLE-v1.md base print pricing ($7.99-$12.99/vol) = PHYSICAL book price, separate
Market comps: Patreon $5 entry/$10-20 premium; Uncle John's $6-17/book; weekly newsletters $12/mo-$120/yr; zines $1.50-5/issue

tiers.name: The Feed (Free)
tiers.maps_to: Funnel. Daily real issue (1pg) only — searchable for discovery. Never the full experience.
unlocks: Daily real issue (1pg) — individual searchable posts

tiers.name: The Spinner ($1/issue)
tiers.maps_to: ANCHOR: $1 for the FULL daily (real + 30 AU pages). Establishes per-day value.
unlocks: FULL daily issue = real + 30-page MULTIVERSE AU spins, every day

tiers.name: Weekly Reader ($3/wk = $156/yr)
tiers.maps_to: 7 full issues compiled weekly. $3 vs $7 per-issue = discount, but flexible (no hard commit).
unlocks: Weekly chronicle volume PDF (217pp) + weekly Colonel codec page

tiers.name: Monthly Volume ($10/mo = $120/yr)
tiers.maps_to: MONTH = VOLUME. More content, lower $/day than weekly (commitment discount).

tiers.name: Annual Archive ($99/yr)
tiers.maps_to: YEAR = COMPETENT ARCHIVE. Only 'complete' tier. Cheapest $/day (hardest commit).

daily.product: individual issue post (real 1pg free; full+AU gated Spinner)

monthly_volume.description: Month-as-volume + AU + Colonel essay. Gated Monthly.
